description: The line plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates the accuracy (Pass@8) of three methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—across a range of temperature values from 0.1 to 1.0. The x-axis, labeled “Temperature,” is linearly scaled with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, with major gridlines and tick labels every 2.5 units. The On-policy RL method (orange line with triangle markers) starts at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1, rises sharply to a peak of ~75.0 at 0.2, then fluctuates with a local minimum near 67.0 at 0.7 before ending at ~73.5 at 1.0. The LUFFY method (red line with star markers) begins at ~76.0, dips slightly to ~76.0 at 0.3, then steadily increases to a peak of ~80.5 at 0.8 before declining slightly to ~80.0 at 1.0. The SFT method (teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers) starts at ~76.0, dips to ~70.0 at 0.5, rises to ~76.5 at 0.6, then fluctuates between ~72.0 and ~74.5 before ending at ~74.5 at 1.0. All three lines are connected with solid lines and use distinct markers for visual differentiation.
